title: Design Amazon E-commerce System
description: Model products, categories, cart, checkout, and order tracking.

data.text: Design an e-commerce system like Amazon. Users browse products, add to cart, checkout with multiple payment options, and track orders.

data.title: Product, Cart, and Order
Why snapshot prices?
data.text: Product prices change. CartItem and OrderItem must snapshot the price at the time of addition/order. Never reference Product.Price directly in historical records.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Product is the catalog entity with stock
CartItem snapshots price to preserve history
data.takeaway: E-commerce is a catalog and order-state problem. Snapshots prevent historical data corruption when prices change.
